verdicts.proof: Old 4.1.3 community_submit.dart:268 max:1; submit_common.dart:67 single pickImage, :128 add tile only if photos.length<max. Current community_submit.dart:351-356 (v2 branch) passes the same max:1 to the same unbranched SubmitPhotosSection (submit_common.dart:57-148, add tile :142). The only entry to the POI form is PoiSubmitScreen, whose v2 and old branches both use this widget. Server: storage policy media_user_poi_upload restricts path user-pois/<uid>/ only, not the count (STATE_5:275); the one-photo limit really comes from user_pois having a single image_url column.

4.1.3 community_submit.dart:154-164 returned silently when GPS gave null. Current _initLocation (community_submit.dart:214-231) is shared by both looks and now calls explainLocation(snack:true) at :221. Both v2 entry points use it: the initState call at :211 and the v2 'use my location' MgBtnText at :340. The pin also stays movable by tapping the map at :305, which is shared. v2 is clearer than 4.1.3.

The insert status 'pending' is in the shared _submit (community_submit.dart:256). The v2 branch keeps SubmitIntroBanner (:334), which in v2 renders SubmitNoteV2 with the same 'submitModerationNote' key (submit_common.dart:24; submit_form_v2.dart:70-88, shield icon). The success sheet showSubmitSuccess also branches to v2 (submit_common.dart:263). Server: RLS user_pois_user_insert requires status='pending' and public read shows only approved rows (STATE_5:107).

4.1.3 :193-198 showed the poiSubmitErr snackbar. The current shared catch (community_submit.dart:266-272) resets busy, keeps the controllers and photos, and calls showErrorSnack with onRetry. The dropped-photo snackbar is at :265. The v2 dock submit (submit_form_v2.dart:62) calls this same _submit through onSubmit (:332).

This guard is not in 4.1.3; it was added on this branch. The PopScope at community_submit.dart:290-296 (canPop:!_dirty, then _confirmLeave and confirmDiscard) and at route_submit_screen.dart:219-225 wraps _buildScaffold, so it covers both looks. In v2 the app-bar back (submit_form_v2.dart:48) uses Navigator.maybePop, which respects PopScope, and the system back gesture hits the same PopScope. confirmDiscard (core/widgets/error_feedback.dart:205-229) shows a v2 dialog look with the same discard / stay outcome. After a successful send, _sent=true (:259) skips the question.

4.1.3 route_submit_screen.dart:138-141 ran the uid check. The same check is now at :146-151 inside the shared _submit, which the v2 dock calls (route_submit_screen.dart:235 -> submit_form_v2.dart:62). The only entry to RouteSubmitScreen is showCommunityAddMenu (community_submit.dart:86-93), which also checks login before pushing the screen. The menu row is shared and only its look is branched (:151-154). v2 opens that menu from moje_view_v2.dart:179 and routes_list_parts_v2.dart:35, both calling the same function. Server: RLS routes_user_submit requires created_by=auth.uid() (STATE_5:107).

4.1.3 :143-146 had the name check. Current route_submit_screen.dart:152-155 has the same check in the shared _submit, which the v2 dock calls (:235). Server: whether routes.name is NOT NULL was not verified (an empty string would pass anyway), so the server side stays unknown.

4.1.3 :147-150 had the two-point check. Current route_submit_screen.dart:156-159 has the same check in the shared _submit, which the v2 dock calls (:235). The _stops list is shared, and the v2 map and stop list use the same _mapBox and _stopsList (:243, :248). Server: routes_user_submit does not check the number of waypoints.

The shared _loadLink (route_submit_screen.dart:69-96) returns early on an empty field (:71) and sets _linkErr to routeSubmitDecodeErr (:92). The v2 SubmitLinkV2 (:340-357) passes onLoad:_decoding?null:_loadLink with the same loading label, and shows okLine/errLine. Its MgBtnInk shows busy (submit_form_v2.dart:186) and the error row has a warning icon (:197-205). An empty field is silent in both looks.

The v2 branch (route_submit_screen.dart:256-261) passes max:6 to the same SubmitPhotosSection as 4.1.3 (:219-224). The cut-off is shared at submit_common.dart:83 (sublist to max), the counter n/6 at :109-120, and the add tile is hidden at :142. The widget is not branched for v2.

The shared _busy flag is set in _submit (route_submit_screen.dart:160). v2 passes busy and busyLabel (:233-235). SubmitScaffoldV2 sets MgCta onTap to null while busy (submit_form_v2.dart:62), and MgCta itself also blocks the tap and shows a spinner (mg_cta.dart:137, :215-217). The 'Uploading' / 'Sending' label appears as a live-region context line in the dock (:58-60). PoiSubmitScreen works the same way (community_submit.dart:330-332).

_dirty includes _stops.isNotEmpty (route_submit_screen.dart:207). The PopScope at :219-225 wraps both looks. The v2 back uses maybePop (submit_form_v2.dart:48), and system back hits the same PopScope, which leads to confirmDiscard.

The shared _submit inserts status 'pending' and is_active false (route_submit_screen.dart:184-185). The v2 branch keeps SubmitIntroBanner (:237), which renders SubmitNoteV2 with 'submitModerationNote' (submit_common.dart:24). Server: RLS routes_user_submit requires status='pending' AND is_active=false (STATE_5:107).
